# `aitbc node remove`

Remove a node from the local configuration.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc node remove [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--node-id` | text | — | yes | The Node id. |
| `--force` | flag | `false` | no | Force removal without confirmation |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc node remove --node-id <node_id>
```
